greeting: Hi! I am the {brand} assistant. I can help you find promotions, discounted products, catalogs and offers. What are you looking for today?
thanks: You are welcome! Can I help you with promotions, catalogs or offers?
how_it_works: {brand} brings promotions, catalogs and offers from many stores into one place. 1) Search for a product or store. 2) Compare prices and discounts. 3) Use the offer you like and get the discount.
account: A {brand} account is free: sign up with your email or a social account. If you forgot your password, choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page. Please never type your password in the chat.
mobile_app: The {brand} mobile app keeps your loyalty cards, coupons and favourite store promotions at hand.
partners: To publish promotions on {brand}, create a partner account and fill in your company details. For partnerships write to {contactEmail}.
contact: You can write to {contactEmail} or call {contactPhone}. If you want to talk to an operator, type "operator".
operator: I have notified the {brand} team and an operator will join as soon as possible. Meanwhile I can keep helping you.
off_topic: Sorry, I can only answer questions about {brand}: promotions, products, catalogs, offers, stores, your account and the app.
injection: I can only help with questions about {brand}. I do not follow other instructions and I do not open external links. What are you looking for?
search_product: Type the name of a product or a store and I will show you the active offers.
results_query: Here are the results for your search:
results_company: Here is what %s has right now:
results_company_query: Here is what I found at %2$s:
results_category: Here is what I found in the "%s" category:
results_promotions: Here are some promotions active today:
results_booklets: Here are the newest active catalogs:
results_place: Here is what I found in %s:
results_discount: Here are the promotions with the biggest discounts right now:
results_companies_count: Here are the partner stores with the most active promotions right now:
clarify_search: I could not find active offers for your search. The product may have another name in the catalogs, try a synonym, the brand or a more general word.
clarify_generic: I am not sure what you are looking for. Tell me a product, a store or an occasion.
no_results: I could not find active offers for your search. Try another word.
no_results_generic: I could not find matching active offers right now. Try another word.
no_results_company: %s has no active offers right now.
no_results_place: I could not find active offers in %s.
no_raffles: I could not find matching active contests.
no_recipes: I could not find recipes for your search.
raffles_off: There are no active contests right now. Meanwhile I can help you with today's promotions.
categories_intro: Here are the available categories — pick one or type its name:
categories_empty: Type the category you are interested in (for example "electronics").
location_generic: Tell me the city (for example "promotions in London") and I will show you the offers there.
page_link: You will find the information on the [%s](%s) page.
unknown: I am not sure I understood. Type, for example, the name of a product or a store.
system.CLOSED: The conversation was closed. Thank you!
system.ESCALATED_WAITING: I have notified a {brand} colleague. Please wait a moment, they will join shortly.
system.ESCALATED_NO_OPERATOR: No operators are available right now. You can write to {contactEmail} or call {contactPhone}.{schedule}
system.AI_UNAVAILABLE: I cannot answer right now. Please try again shortly or type "operator".
settings.welcome: Hi! I am {botName}, your assistant for promotions, catalogs and offers. How can I help you today?
llm.operator_draft: DRAFT MODE: you write a draft answer that a {brand} operator reviews and sends to the visitor. Write on behalf of the {brand} team, politely, without saying you are a bot.
llm.fallback_prompt: You are the {brand} assistant. Answer only about the {brand} platform, briefly, in English, only from the data in <items> and <knowledge>. Answer strictly in JSON {"text","ids","confidence","escalate"}.
crisis.self_harm: I am really sorry you are going through this. You are not alone. If you are in immediate danger, please call {emergency} now.{helplines} If you want, a {brand} colleague can write to you right now.
crisis.danger: I am really sorry you are in this situation. Your safety matters most. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, please call {emergency} now.{helplines} If you want, a {brand} colleague can write to you right now.
crisis.helpline: You can also talk for free to {helpline}.
abuse.boundary: Let us keep the conversation respectful, please. I can help you with promotions, products, catalogs or offers on {brand}.
abuse.hate: I do not accept messages that insult or discriminate against people. Let us keep the conversation respectful, please. I can help you with promotions, products, catalogs or offers on {brand}.
abuse.minors: I cannot continue this conversation. Any sexual content involving minors is forbidden and the message has been reported to the {brand} team.
external_link: I can only send links to {brand} pages. Tell me what you are looking for and I will show you the matching promotions or offers.
external_link_company: I cannot send external links, but on {brand} you will find the %s store page: [%s](%s).
restricted: I cannot help with this topic. I can help you with promotions, products, catalogs and offers on {brand}.
scenario_header: Here is a suggestion for %s with the best active deals:
scenario_total: Estimated total: %1$s out of a %2$s budget.
scenario_people_note: For %d people, adjust the quantities as needed.
results_category_fallback: No exact match, but here are deals from the “%s” category:
closest_matches: No exact match. Here are the closest results — tell me if you meant something else:
results_min_discount: Here are deals with at least %d%% off:
recommend_header: Here are the best discounts right now — tell me the occasion and I will make you a list:
basket_note: Quantities are approximate — adjust them to your habits.
nutrition_total: Total: ~%1$d kcal · protein %2$d g · fat %3$d g · carbs %4$d g.
nutrition_disclaimer: Approximate values from general nutrition tables — not medical advice.
nutrition_refuse: I cannot make meal plans for medical diets or health conditions. Please talk to a doctor or dietitian; meanwhile I can help with deals on the products you need.
compare_stores_header: I compared "%s" across the stores on OMY (lowest price in each):
compare_stores_best: Cheapest at **%1$s** (%2$s). Compared to %3$s you save %4$s (−%5$d%%).
compare_stores_missing: %1$s has no offers for "%2$s" right now, but the stores above do.
compare_basket_header: I compared a basic basket (%s) across the stores on OMY:
compare_basket_best: Best basket right now: **%1$s** — total %2$s. Its products are below.
store_location: All %1$s stores with addresses and opening hours are on the [OMY map](/map) and on the [%1$s page](%2$s). Here are their current offers:
store_schedule: Opening hours differ between %1$s stores — see them for each address on the [OMY map](/map) and on the [%1$s page](%2$s).
store_loyalty: You can keep your %1$s loyalty card in the OMY app: in your profile, under "Discount cards", add it with a photo or the code and show it at the checkout. [Mobile app](/pages/mobile-app) · [%1$s page](%2$s)
store_alternatives: %1$s has no offers for "%2$s" right now. Here is where to find "%2$s" at the best price:
about_bot: I am OMY, the virtual assistant of the OMY platform — a program, not a person. I help you find promotions and catalogues, compare prices across stores, build a shopping basket on a budget and answer questions about your account and the app. What are you looking for today?
no_orders: OMY does not sell products or place orders: we show promotions, catalogues and prices from partner stores, and you buy directly in the store. I can find the best offer for what you need — just tell me.
followup_cheaper: I looked for cheaper options for "%s":
followup_already_cheapest: Nothing cheaper — these are already the best prices for "%s":
followup_more: More offers for "%s" that I have not shown yet:
followup_alternative: Here is another option with the same preferences:
followup_discount: I kept the search "%s" and left only discounted offers:
followup_excluded: I kept the rest and removed: %s.
followup_people: I kept your preferences and recalculated for %d people.
followup_price: I kept the search and set the limit to %s.
followup_store: For %1$s, here are the offers for "%2$s":
followup_recipes: Recipes with "%s" from the OMY blog:

where_unknown: %1$s — open the offer to see the store and addresses on the [OMY map](/map).
list_add: You can save **%1$s** to your shopping list: open the [product](%2$s) and tap "Add to list" (a free OMY account is needed).
compare_shown_best: My pick: **%1$s** — the best price among them.
price_relaxed: I found no "%1$s" %2$s, but the lowest price right now is %3$s — here are the offers, cheapest first:
discount_relaxed: I found no discounts of at least %1$d%% for "%2$s". The biggest discount right now is −%3$d%%:

query_dropped: I did not find exactly "%s", but here is what I found:
place_relaxed: I found no "%1$s" in %2$s stores, but here are the best offers in other cities:
booklets_for_category: Catalogues of the stores with the most "%s" offers:
followup_cheaper_generic: Here are cheaper options than the ones above:
followup_more_generic: More offers I have not shown you yet:
followup_discount_generic: I kept only the discounted offers:
clarify_examples: Examples that work: "cheapest milk", "coffee under 50 lei", "Linella offers", "BBQ for 6 under 500 lei", "new catalogs".
unit_header: Best value for "%1$s" by price per %2$s (based on the size in the product name):

unit_note: Check the size on the shelf label, the calculation is approximate.
memory_login: I can remember your preferences (stores, products, city) only when you are signed in to your {brand} account. [Sign in](/auth/login) and message me again.
memory_view_header: Here is what I remember about you:
memory_view_empty: I don't remember anything about you yet. As you look for deals, I note your favourite stores and products — only to show you relevant offers faster.
memory_line_paused: Memory is paused: I don't learn anything new and don't use what I know. Write "resume memory" to turn it back on.
memory_price_cheapest: you often look for the cheapest
memory_view_footer_item: You can write "forget %s", "forget everything" or "stop remembering". It is also in the chat menu under "What {brand} knows about me".
memory_view_footer: You can write "forget everything" or "stop remembering". It is also in the chat menu under "What {brand} knows about me".
memory_forgot_all: Done, I forgot everything I knew about you. We start from scratch.
memory_forget_unknown: I couldn't find "%s" among the things I remember. Write "what do you know about me?" to see the list.
memory_paused: Memory is paused: I won't learn anything new or use what I know. Write "resume memory" when you want it back.
memory_resumed: Memory is back on: I remember your favourite stores and products to show you relevant offers faster.
memory_already_paused: Memory is already paused. Write "resume memory" to turn it back on.
memory_remember_store: Got it, you prefer %s. When you don't name a store I'll look there first — and still tell you if it's cheaper elsewhere.
memory_remember_rejected: I can only remember shopping preferences: stores, products, brands, city, budget or dietary preferences (for example "remember that I shop at Linella").
memory_remember_pii: I don't keep personal data such as email, phone or card numbers. I can only remember shopping preferences.
memory_remember_paused: Memory is paused, so I didn't save anything. Write "resume memory" to turn it back on.
memory_remember_empty: What should I remember? For example: "remember that I shop at Linella".
memory_welcome_last_store: Last time you looked for **%1$s** at %2$s.
memory_welcome_new_one: There is a new offer for %s:
memory_welcome_active: There are %1$d active offers for %2$s right now:
memory_welcome_active_one: There is one active offer for %s right now:
memory_tip_new: Tip: there are %1$d new offers for %2$s, which you often look for.
memory_tip_new_one: Tip: there is a new offer for %s, which you often look for.
memory_welcome_hint: Write "what do you know about me?" to see what I remember, or "forget everything".
memory_default_store: At %s, as usual – or do you want all stores?
memory_default_store_empty: I couldn't find "%2$s" at %1$s right now, so here are all stores:
memory_last_shown_expired: The offers I showed you last time (%1$s) are no longer valid. Here is what I find now for "%2$s":
memory_nothing_last: I don't have an earlier conversation with you saved yet. Tell me what you're looking for and I'll help now.
